request.text_style_prompt: Match the reference bow: old reddish brown carved wood, warm worn brass curled nocks and pierced riser ornaments, black leather wrapped grip. Three arrows mounted beside the lower bow limb and the separate arrow have thin dark wooden shafts, small aged iron arrowheads and ivory feather fletchings. The two holder bands are dark worn leather. Realistic worn medieval materials, no glowing parts, no writing, no modern parts. Keep every surface and silhouette unchanged.

requested_scope: complete production including rig, bow contact, all tiers and runtime integration
substep: Continuous attack opening installed and verified
agent_visual_review: complete: references, fitted geometry, all exported clips, materials, hands, feet, contacts, tiers and native GPU comparisons
user_artistic_acceptance: General appearance approved; attack opening revised in response to feedback.

next_action.action: Review the smoother Attack opening in the updated viewer.
